summary: Implemented and verified `bootstrap-nextjs-app`. The project root now has a Next.js TypeScript App Router application with framework-native `src/app` structure, package scripts for `dev`, `build`, `lint`, and `test:e2e`, and a Customer Feedback Portal home route without default starter boilerplate. Fixed bootstrap verification issues by using `next/link` for the root route, ignoring generated Next artifacts in ESLint, and pinning Next output tracing to the project root. Evidence: `npm run lint` passed; `npm run build` passed; required script validation passed; boilerplate text scan returned no matches. Playwright tests were not run for this story because the current acceptance criterion only requires the execution script to exist.
